usageNotes: Retrieves a single firewall rule for an LXC container by its zero-based position in the ruleset. Use this to inspect a specific rule's full details (action, proto, ports, source/dest, enable state) before modifying or deleting it. Requires VM.Audit on /vms/{vmid}; the container does not need to be running.

examples.summary: Fetch the first firewall rule for LXC 200 on node pve1

tips: Rule positions are zero-indexed; use get_nodes_node_lxc_vmid_firewall_rules (list) first to enumerate positions before fetching a specific one.
The 'enable' field returns 0 (disabled) or 1 (enabled) as an integer, not a boolean.
If 'macro' is set, it overrides proto/dport/sport — individual port/protocol fields may be absent or ignored.
